title: Creative Associate – Photo & Video Documentation
description:
**SERVICE DESCRIPTION**

***Creative Associate – Photo \& Video Documentation***

**Organisation:** Elixir Foundation  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience Required:** 6 Months – 1 Year (Freshers with strong portfolio may be considered)  
**Educational Qualification:** Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree  
**Compensation:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month

***About Elixir Foundation***

Elixir Foundation is a youth\-run organisation founded by President Award Winners, Government of India, working to unleash the power of youth by nurturing potential young leaders through meaningful community engagement and service.

The organisation works across diverse thematic areas including Youth Leadership, Health \& Hygiene, Child Rights, Heritage Conservation \& Preservation, Disaster Relief, Environment, Education, Community Mobilisation, Community Skilling Programs, Gender Equality, Youth Governance, and other social impact initiatives.

***Position Overview***

Elixir Foundation is seeking a young, proactive, energetic, and socially driven **Associate – Programs** to support the execution and coordination of its ongoing programs, campaigns, and community initiatives. The selected candidate will work closely with the program team in implementing field activities, coordinating stakeholders, maintaining documentation, and supporting operational processes across projects.

This role is ideal for young professionals passionate about social impact, youth development, and grassroots engagement.

***Key Roles \& Responsibilities***

**1\. Photography \& Videography**

· Capture high\-quality photographs and videos of events, workshops, campaigns, and field activities.

· Document grassroots\-level impact stories, community engagement, and beneficiary interactions.

· Ensure proper framing, lighting, and storytelling through visuals.

**2\. Video Editing \& Post\-Production**

· Edit raw footage into engaging short videos, reels, documentaries, and highlight films.

· Add subtitles, transitions, music, and branding elements as required.

· Ensure timely delivery of edited content for social media and reporting.

**3\. Creative Communication \& Branding Support**

· Support development of visual storytelling aligned with organisational branding.

· Maintain consistency in tone, style, and visual identity across all creative outputs.

· Assist in ideation of campaign visuals and communication materials.

**4\. Documentation of Events \& Activities**

· Maintain systematic photo and video documentation of all organisational activities.

· Create event summaries through visual storytelling formats.

· Develop impact\-driven case study videos and success stories.

**5\. Content Planning \& Execution**

· Collaborate with communication and program teams to plan content requirements.

· Pre\-plan shoots based on event calendars and field activities.

· Suggest creative ideas for improving content quality and engagement.

**6\. Coordination with Teams**

· Work closely with field teams, program managers, and volunteers for content capture.

· Coordinate logistics for shoot requirements during field visits.

· Ensure smooth execution of documentation during events and campaigns.

**7\. Designing Promotional \& Outreach Materials**

· Support in creating posters, banners, social media creatives, and digital campaign materials.

· Assist in designing visuals for awareness campaigns and events.

· Ensure alignment with organisational branding guidelines.

**8\. Digital Media Management \& Archiving**

· Maintain and organise a structured archive of all photos, videos, and creative assets.

· Ensure proper labelling, storage, and retrieval of media files.

· Manage digital content libraries for future use and reporting.

**9\. Field Support \& Travel**

· Travel to field locations, community areas, schools, and project sites as required.

· Provide on\-ground support during large\-scale events and campaigns.

***Required Skills and Competencies***

· Strong photography and videography skills

· Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, etc.)

· Basic knowledge of graphic design tools (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator preferred)

· Strong storytelling and visual communication abilities

· Creativity and attention to detail

· Ability to work in field conditions and dynamic environments

· Good teamwork, coordination, and time management skills

· Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and basic AI tools

***Eligibility Criteria***

·Diploma/Bachelor’s Degree in Media, Communication, Design, Social Work, or related field

·6 months to 1 year of relevant experience in photography/videography/content creation (NGO experience preferred)

·Freshers with strong portfolio, internship, or freelance work may also apply

***What We Offer***

·Opportunity to work on impactful grassroots and youth\-led initiatives

·Exposure to government, institutional, and international collaborations

·Dynamic and purpose\-driven work environment

·Opportunity for learning, leadership and professional growth

***How to Apply***

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with a cover letter/email expressing their interest in the role to *president@elixirindia.org* marking *career@elixirindia.org* in cc.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Property Valuation
description:
Job Title: Site Visitor \& Report Writer

Location: Ahmedabad

Company: Prime Value Appraisals

Job Role Overview:

We are hiring enthusiastic individuals for a dual role involving property site visits and technical report preparation. You will play a key part in the valuation process, gathering on\-site data and preparing structured reports for our clients.

\-\-\-

Key Responsibilities:

1\. Site Visitor (Field Work):

Visit residential, commercial, and industrial properties

Measure and inspect properties for valuation purposes

Take photos and gather property\-related details

Coordinate with clients and site owners for timely visits

2\. Report Writer (Office Work):

Prepare property valuation reports based on field data

Use MS Word/Excel for formatting and documentation

Ensure accuracy, clarity, and timely submission of reports

Coordinate with senior valuers for review and updates

\-\-\-

Requirements:

Diploma/Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or related field (preferred)

Freshers welcome; prior experience in valuation/reporting is a plus

Basic computer knowledge (MS Word/Excel)

Good observation and communication skills

Willingness to travel locally for site visits

Bike \& Licence

\-\-\-

Job Type: Full\-Time

Work Locations: Ahmedabad  
Salary: As per industry standards

\-\-\-

Join a fast\-growing valuation firm and build your career in a dynamic, field \+ office\-based role.

title: IT Resume Specialist
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services  
**Shift:** Overnight(US time zone)

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.

Work Location: In person
